title: pack's priced note reads any 'how much ... per user, device, month or year' as a money ask, so memory or data quantities get a check: and route split
goal: good packs of 'How much memory per device does the Intune agent use?', 'How much data per month can the Graph usage reports return?' and 'How many resource units does a Graph getMemberGroups call cost?' carry no priced note and no route split, while 'How much is a Microsoft 365 E5 licence per user per month?' and 'What is the current price of a Microsoft 365 E5 licence?' keep it (the how-much alternative BG-j7pe3u46 added to PRICE_ASK, which exempts a unit only after 'cost ... in', found by the SP-4o3plg4l review and merged with BG-euirq6se)

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;bad=[q for q in ('How much memory per device does the Intune agent use?','How much data per month can the Graph usage reports return?','How many resource units does a Graph getMemberGroups call cost?') if kbfacts.pack(q).get('priced')]+[q for q in ('How much is a Microsoft 365 E5 licence per user per month?','What is the current price of a Microsoft 365 E5 licence?') if not kbfacts.PRICE_ASK.search(q)];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

gates.question: How does PRICE_ASK tell a memory, data or unit quantity from a money ask?

notes: Merged from BG-euirq6se “pack's priced note fires on a unit cost asked as 'how many <units> does X cost', which asks for no money amount” at the 2026-10-13 draft triage: Same PRICE_ASK regex as BG-apytw7fo, same review (SP-4o3plg4l), same fix location. Repro still returns priced=True for the units question; BG-apytw7fo must absorb this question as a second false-priced case. Its goal: a good pack of 'How many resource units does a Graph getMemberGroups call cost?' carries no priced note and no route split, while 'What is the current price of a Microsoft 365 E5 licence?' keeps it (PRICE_ASK exempts a unit only after 'cost ... in'; found by the SP-4o3plg4l review) Its repro: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;p=kbfacts.pack('How many resource units does a Graph getMemberGroups call cost?');print(p.get('priced'));sys.exit(1 if p.get('priced') else 0)"]} Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 2 of 15, "Pack notes, router cost and query-log apply guards read what they should"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise run 2026-10-13 on the base: the repro prints the three false-priced questions and exits 1 (precheck). Depends on nothing; BG-s7du27qb and ST-bbliwg6y follow it (kbfacts.py, test_live_kb.py).
